projects.name: Network Guardian AI
projects.tagline: Self-hosted, offline AI network security tool
projects.description: DNS and network telemetry analysis built for personal use: entropy scoring and Isolation Forest heuristics run locally, Ollama provides offline AI summaries, and results cache so inference is only used when heuristics cannot decide. I run it as my own client, so the product is continuously tested on real traffic.
projects.problem: Network and DNS logs are noisy, and suspicious traffic patterns are hard to explain quickly without additional analysis.
projects.solution: Built a FastAPI service around an AdGuard poller, SQLite domain history, tenant middleware, JWT/API-key auth, local entropy and anomaly scoring, optional Gemini/Ollama analysis, websocket updates, and a React dashboard. Now runs offline on a laptop with cached Ollama inference.
projects.outcome: Runs continuously on my own network for 6+ days, catches novel "zero day"-style domains for this deployment, and keeps cloud AI calls at a minimum through local caching.
achievements: Explored Shannon Entropy for suspicious traffic scoring.
Used Isolation Forests for anomaly detection experiments.
Built containerised prototype services for analysis and summarisation workflows.
Runs fully offline on a laptop using cached Ollama inference.
Serves as my own daily client, so detection heuristics are continuously exercised on real traffic.

projects.name: CodeFlow-Hook

projects.technicalChallenge: Designed the tool around provider abstraction, structured review categories, offline/RAG experimentation, and practical CLI workflows rather than a single hardcoded model path.
achievements: Published an npm package for AI-assisted code review workflows.
Designed multi-agent review categories including security, quality, test impact, dependencies, and architecture.
Added CLI-oriented workflows for practical developer usage.

projects.name: Scrapper
projects.tagline: Local PII scrubber for AI workflows (TDPI-backed)
projects.description: Dockerised local PII scrubber that sits in front of AI workflows: inbound data is scrubbed before reaching a model and outbound responses are checked before reaching the user. Academically grounded in a TDPI paper (March).
projects.problem: Businesses want AI in their workflows but cannot send raw customer data to third-party models. PII leakage is a hard blocker.
projects.solution: A local Docker blackbox that intercepts requests and responses around AI workflows and scrubs PII deterministically, independent of any model.
projects.outcome: Gives businesses an always-on privacy guard so AI can be used without exposing customer data.
achievements: Designed as a drop-in local guard for any AI workflow.
Deterministic scrubbing rules keep behaviour model-independent.

projects.name: BackPocket OS AI
projects.tagline: Local-first AI operations assistant for small businesses
projects.description: Local-first AI operations assistant turning emails, quote requests, documents, voice notes, and follow-ups into structured tasks with human approval before anything leaves the system. BYOK (bring your own key) keeps provider choice and spend with the operator.
projects.problem: Small operators drown in admin work; cloud-first tools are expensive, keyboard-centric, and disconnected from field work.
projects.solution: Operator-owned local AI: emails/docs/voice notes become structured tasks, Ollama handles on-device inference offline, optional escalation uses the operator's own API key (BYOK), and every external action needs explicit approval.
projects.outcome: Defined a local-first product direction for small-business admin automation with privacy and human approval at the centre.
achievements: Modelled messy business inputs as auditable structured workflows.
Kept privacy, local ownership, and human approval central.
